columns.name: AUTO_SYNC_TRACKING_ID
columns.description: Primary Key of the table. System generated.

columns.name: REQUEST_NUMBER
columns.description: To store the HDL submission request number( Latest Request Number)

columns.name: CONTENT_ID
columns.description: To store the Content ID returned from UCM after uploading the document.

columns.name: CONTENT_UPLOAD_ERROR
columns.description: To store any Error message while uploading to Content Server

columns.name: HDL_SUBMIT_ERROR
columns.description: To store any Error message while submitting a HDL Request

columns.name: HDL_PROCESSING_ERROR
columns.description: To store any Error message while processing a HDL Request

columns.name: OFFER_ACCEPT_ERROR
columns.description: To store any Error message while Accepting an Offer via API

columns.name: HDL_INPUT_JSON
columns.description: To store Json with Input Parameters sent to HDL

columns.name: GHR_API_INPUT_JSON
columns.description: To store Json with Input Parameters sent to GHR

columns.name: GHR_API_OUTPUT_JSON
columns.description: To store Json with Output Parameters received from GHR

columns.name: GHR_API_ERROR
columns.description: To store GHR API Error Message.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
